arxiv-1804-10922.title: OPA2Vec: combining formal and informal content of biomedical ontologies to improve similarity-based prediction
arxiv-1804-10922.creator: Fatima Zohra Smaili \sfb 1, Xin Gao \sfb 1, ∗ {}^{\text{\sfb 1,}*} and Robert Hoehndorf \sfb 1, ∗ {}^{\text{\sfb 1,}*}
arxiv-1804-10922.description: Abstract Motivation: Ontologies are widely used in biology for data annotation, integration, and analysis. In addition to formally structured axioms, ontologies contain meta-data in the form of annotation axioms which provide valuable pieces of information that characterize ontology classes. Annotations commonly used in ontologies include class labels, descriptions, or synonyms.

arxiv-2012-03913.title: Centrality of nodes in Federated Byzantine Agreement Systems
arxiv-2012-03913.creator: André Gaul and Jörg Liesen
arxiv-2012-03913.description: Abstract The federated Byzantine agreement system (FBAS) is a consensus model introduced by Mazières in 2016 [ 25 ] where the participating nodes conceptually form a network, with links between them being established by each node individually and thus in a decentralized way. An important question is whether these decentralized decisions lead to an overall decentralized network.

arxiv-2310-08171.title: Search for direct production of electroweakinos in final states with one lepton, jets and missing transverse momentum in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2310-08171.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2310-08171.description: Abstract Searches for electroweak production of wino-like chargino pairs, χ ~ 1 + ​ χ ~ 1 − \tilde{\chi}^{+}_{1}\tilde{\chi}^{-}_{1} , and of wino-like chargino and next-to-lightest neutralino, χ ~ 1 ± ​ χ ~ 2 0 \tilde{\chi}^{\pm}_{1}\tilde{\chi}^{0}_{2} , are presented.

arxiv-2402-02799.title: Thermal x-ray studies of neutron stars and the equation of state
arxiv-2402-02799.creator: Zhiqiang Miao ID 1,2, Liqiang Qi 3, Juan Zhang 3, Ang Li ID 2, Mingyu Ge 3
arxiv-2402-02799.description: Abstract The understanding of neutron star equation of state hinges on a comprehensive analysis of multi-messenger, multi-wavelength data. The recent scrutiny of PSR J0030+0451 data by NICER introduces complexities, unveiling a tension with another x-ray observation of the central compact object in HESS J1731-347, specifically concerning the mass-radius constraint of low-mass neutron stars.

arxiv-2410-15408.title: Bailey Pairs and an Identity of Chern–Li–Stanton–Xue–Yee
arxiv-2410-15408.creator: Shashank KANADE a and Jeremy LOVEJOY b
arxiv-2410-15408.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shashank KANADE a and Jeremy LOVEJOY b. We show how Bailey pairs can be used to give a simple proof of an identity of Chern, Li, Stanton, Xue, and Yee. The same method yields a number of related identities as well as false theta companions. This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Basic Hypergeometric Series Associated with Root Systems and Applications in honor of Stephen C. Milne’s 75th birthday. The full collection is available at
https://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/Milne.html
.

arxiv-2412-13053.title: SMoSE : Sparse Mixture of Shallow Experts for Interpretable Reinforcement Learning in Continuous Control Tasks
arxiv-2412-13053.creator: Mátyás Vincze, Laura Ferrarotti, Leonardo Lucio Custode, Bruno Lepri, Giovanni Iacca
arxiv-2412-13053.description: Abstract Continuous control tasks often involve high-dimensional, dynamic, and non-linear environments. State-of-the-art performance in these tasks is achieved through complex closed-box policies that are effective, but suffer from an inherent opacity. Interpretable policies, while generally underperforming compared to their closed-box counterparts, advantageously facilitate transparent decision-making within automated systems.

pmc-10631425.title: Congenital leukemia: A case report and review of literature
pmc-10631425.creator: Chun-Xia Yang, Ying Yang, Fen-Li Zhang, Ding-Huan Wang, Qiu-Han Bian, Man Zhou, Ming-Xiang Zhou, Xiao-Yan Yang
pmc-10631425.description: BACKGROUNDAcute leukemia in newborns is also known as neonatal or congenital leukemia (CL) and is a rare disease with an incidence rate of 1-5 per 1000000 live births. After birth, infants with CL exhibit infiltrative cutaneous nodules, hepatosplenomegaly, thrombocytopenia, and immature leukocytes in the peripheral blood.

pmc-11356741.title: Cavity-Tuned Exciton Dynamics in Transition Metal Dichalcogenides Monolayers
pmc-11356741.creator: Kaijun Shen, Kewei Sun, Maxim F Gelin, Yang Zhao, Vlassios Likodimos, Andres Sotelo, George Kioseoglou
pmc-11356741.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A fully quantum, numerically accurate methodology is presented for the simulation of the exciton dynamics and time-resolved fluorescence of cavity-tuned two-dimensional (2D) materials at finite temperatures. This approach was specifically applied to a monolayer WSe2 system. Our methodology enabled us to identify the dynamical and spectroscopic signatures of polaronic and polaritonic effects and to elucidate their characteristic timescales across a range of exciton–cavity couplings.

pmc-11644402.title: Silver-Catalyzed Aqueous Electrochemical Valorization of Soda Lignin into Aliphatics and Phenolics
pmc-11644402.creator: Lucie Lindenbeck, Silas Brand, Franka Stallmann, Vanessa Barra, Marcella Frauscher, Björn B Beele, Adam Slabon, Bruno V Manzolli Rodrigues, Bin Zhao
pmc-11644402.description: Transitioning from crude oil to renewable sources of carbon-based chemicals is critical for advancing sustainable development. Lignin, a wood-derived biomacromolecule, holds great potential as a renewable feedstock, but efficient depolymerization and dearomatization methods are required to fully unlock its potential.

pmc-12428038.title: Professional Quality of Life Among Civilian Dentists During Military Conflicts: A Survey Study
pmc-12428038.creator: Yaniv Mayer, Maayan Atzmon Shavit, Eran Gabay, Thabet Asbi, Hadar Zigdon Giladi, Leon Bilder, Gorce Philippe
pmc-12428038.description: Background: Dental professionals are particularly susceptible to occupational stress and burnout, which are amplified during armed conflicts. Civilian dentists continuing to provide care under wartime conditions face unique psychological challenges. This study aimed to evaluate their psychological wellbeing and professional quality of life during military conflict.

pmc-12502482.title: Key factors impacting morning report learning in emergency residency training: a multicenter qualitative study
pmc-12502482.creator: Omar Alghamdi, Salman Alotaibi, Ali Alkhulaif, Sarah Alqahtani, Ali Basfar, Muna Aljahany
pmc-12502482.description: BackgroundMorning reports are essential educational tools in medical training that promote clinical reasoning, communication, and decision-making. However, their impact in emergency medicine (EM) remains unexplored. This study identified factors that enhance or hinder learning in EM morning report sessions in Saudi Arabia.

pmc-12509836.title: Genetic heterogeneity and key driver mutations in the preneoplastic and earliest stages of gastric cancer
pmc-12509836.creator: Eduardo Alfonso Marroquín-Estrada, Héctor Martínez-Gregorio, Clara Estela Díaz-Velásquez, Fernando Ambriz-Barrera, Eduardo Emilio Córdoba-García, Laura Itzel Hernández-Romero, Miguel Ruiz De-La-Cruz, Armando Cáceres, Elisa Hernández, José Rodolfo Gil, Elizabeth Orellana, Daniel Penados, Carolina Ric
pmc-12509836.description: BackgroundGastric cancer (GC) is the fifth-leading cause of cancer-related mortality, with a 5-year survival rate less than 20%. It develops from preneoplastic lesions to adenocarcinoma, but these early genetic alterations remain poorly understood. Therefore, we aimed to identify early genetic drivers underlying the development of preneoplastic lesions and the initiation of gastric carcinogenesis.

pmc-12561548.title: The Optimal Fibular Strut Bone Graft Fixation Angle for Unstable Proximal Humerus Fractures: A Finite Element Analysis
pmc-12561548.creator: Hyun Seok Song, Hui-Gyeong Gong, Hyun-Ju Lee, Hyungsuk Kim, Ki-Sik Tae
pmc-12561548.description: Adding a fibular strut bone graft to locking plate fixation has been introduced to improve stability and prevent varus collapse. The purpose of this study was to perform finite element analysis (FEA) of the biomechanical characteristics of different insertion angles of the fibular strut graft in proximal humerus fractures.

pmc-13156482.title: Bilateral risk-reducing mastectomy under awake regional anaesthesia with immediate prepectoral reconstruction using lightweight implants in a patient with severe cardiomyopathy: a case report
pmc-13156482.creator: Roberto Gennari, Lorenzo Guarrera, Anna Trapani, Virginia Scorsone, Giovanni Misseri
pmc-13156482.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Risk-reducing mastectomy is an established preventive strategy for carriers of pathogenic germline mutations. In patients with severe cardiomyopathy, general anaesthesia may represent a prohibitive risk. Awake regional anaesthesia may offer a feasible alternative in selected high-risk patients. A 51-year-old woman with a pathogenic ATM mutation and severe hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (NYHA III–IV, ASA IV) underwent bilateral nipple-sparing risk-reducing mastectomy under awake thoracic regional anaesthesia using bilateral erector spinae plane and intertransverse process blocks with conscious sedation.

pmc-13243085.title: Comparative efficacy and safety of ursodeoxycholic acid, fibrates, and combination therapy in primary biliary cholangitis: an umbrella meta-analysis of meta-analyses
pmc-13243085.creator: Jian Zhang, Ting Xiu, Qi Shen
pmc-13243085.description: BackgroundPrimary biliary cholangitis (PBC) is a chronic autoimmune liver disease characterized by progressive cholestasis. Although ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) is the standard therapy, a substantial proportion of patients show inadequate response, highlighting the need for alternative or adjunct treatments. Fibrates have emerged as adjunct agents to UDCA, but evidence remains inconsistent across trials and meta-analyses.

pmc-13491251.title: Species‐level controls of foliar methane and nitrous oxide fluxes: roles of traits and microbes in temperate trees
pmc-13491251.creator: Md Rezaul Karim, Sean C. Thomas
pmc-13491251.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Summary The contribution of tree foliage to atmospheric methane (CH4) and nitrous oxide (N2O) fluxes remains uncertain in global greenhouse gas (GHG) budgets. pmc-13669904.title: PbSnRK1‐Mediated Phosphorylation of PbTCP13 Regulates Glucose‐Responsive Lignin Biosynthesis via PbMYB11 During Pear Stone Cell Formation
pmc-13669904.creator: Jianan He, Xuxu Wang, Abdul Basit, Wen Li, Jiahui Chao, Wenyu Zhao, Mingxu Niu, Xin Yan, Yuanhui Yu, Kaijie Qi, Zhihua Xie, Shaoling Zhang, Katsuhiro Shiratake, Khanizadeh Shahrokh, Shutian Tao
pmc-13669904.description: Stone cell lignification is a key determinant of pear fruit texture and commercial quality, and this process has been reported to be tightly coupled to cellular glucose availability. However, how glucose dose‐dependently targets transcription factor phosphorylation during lignin biosynthesis remains largely unknown.
